product_metadata.title: Elite Platinum EPB-5455 Nutri-Blender, Black
features: Transform whole fruits, nuts, vegetables, seeds and other superfoods into supreme liquid power for your body
6 stainless steel blades with Titanium coating to prevent enzyme & vitamin loss, also reduce smoothie oxidation
BPA free 33oz and 27oz durable Tritan material on-the-go blending cups with one spill-proof lid and one sealing lid
One-touch operation with digital count-down timer and START/STOP, PULSE, BLEND, EXTRA BLEND buttons
description: The Elite Platinum Smart Blender with Hi-Q technology is a powerful workhorse capable of breaking down ingredients such as fruits and vegetables to a perfectly, smooth consistency. No lumps, clumps, or chunks here! With a range of settings that go from Blend, Extra Blend, and Pulse, the Hi-Q smart blender can handle any job you throw at it. A powerful 1200 Watt Motor linked to 6 high quality stainless steel blades cut through any task making it ideal for making fresh fruit/vegetable/fitness beverages, milkshakes, cocktails, salsas, soups, baby food, and even crushing ice! Includes 2 BPA-free Blender Cups that you can take on the go! A convenient countdown timer allows you to achieve the perfect blend. Use your Hi-Q and Blend Smart!
